name: smart-student-backend
description: Backend for Smart Student Management & Biometric Attendance System

scripts.seed: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const mysql = require('mysql2/promise'); const fs = require('fs'); const pool = mysql.createPool({host: process.env.DB_HOST, user: process.env.DB_USER, password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD, database: process.env.DB_NAME}); pool.query(fs.readFileSync('./schema.sql', 'utf8')).then(() => {console.log('Schema imported'); process.exit(0)}).catch(e => {console.error(e); process.exit(1)});"
